proposal.summary: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Roxy WI <= v6.1.1.0 via uploading or manipulating ssl_cert through a POST to /app/options.py allowing command execution (e.g. injected wget).
proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm the vulnerable parameter handling in /app/options.py by reproducing the POST, identify how input is passed to system/command execution, and apply input validation or use safe APIs. If confirmed, notify vendor and prepare patch to sanitize or remove shell invocation; advise immediate mitigation (network access restrictions) until fixed.

evidence_quotes.claim: HTTP request demonstrating unauthenticated POST to options.py
Advisory title stating unauthenticated RCE via ssl_cert upload
evidence_quotes.quote: Exploit Title: Roxy WI v6.1.1.0 - Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) via ssl_cert Upload
